contexts.text: Some Genii, or rather furies...
Aiming the knives at the breasts of others, like furies.
(Such women) become like furies. Described.
(It is said according to the appearance) that Jehovah is in... fury against the wicked. AC 3605:4. AC 4307:2.

He said that there was there such a fury of insanity against good and truth, and especially against the Lord, that he was amazed it could possibly be resisted... Therefore, unless that fury were continually repelled by the Lord, the whole human race would perish. DMin 4682:2.
Cursed be their anger because it was vehement, and their fury because it was heavy () = the penalty of turning away from truth and good... Anger = recession from truth; and fury, from good.
Hatred... is as it were spiritual antipathy; and therefore, in the other life, the moment they perceive the sphere of him against whom they have felt hatred, they come as it were into fury.
Here, fury, anger, etc., = nothing but the evils of penalty on account of turning away from and assault upon good and truth. Illustrated. AC 5798:6.
By anger, fury, etc., are meant the punishments and damnations into which man casts himself, when he casts himself into evils. Illustrated.
The fury of cupidities... with the evil. Signified.
Therefore they come into fury when they perceive the blessedness of the upright.

It is as if fury takes possession of us when we see any Angel, and feel the Divine sphere about him. Then I said, So you are like wild beasts; on hearing which fury came upon them, which appeared like the fire of hatred. CL 461:8.

He treadeth the winepress of the fury and anger of Almighty God () = that the Lord alone endured all the evils of the Church, and all the violence offered to the Word, thus to Himself. The wine of the fury and anger of God = the goods and truths of the Church, which are from the Word, profaned and adulterated, thus the evils and falsities of the Church.
As they approached (the angelic pair) they became like furies.
When (confirmed adulterers) perceive the sphere of marriage love... if they harden themselves against it, they are exasperated with fury, and become like furies.
Hell attacks all those (who are being regenerated) with diabolical fury...
All satans cannot endure to hear any truth from the Word, or to hear Jesus named: if they hear it, they become like furies...
The Lord Himself does not descend, but an Angel... I have sometimes seen the wicked terrified by that descent... and some driven into furies.
That the worst Genii, or furies, are shut up in Hell...

The bond is relaxed to them... when man falls into furies. I have experienced these furies... that I might tell of them. When I had written these things the reins were relaxed a little to these furies...
They complained of those free Spirits, or those furies, who are still entertained in the third Heaven.
Thus they are as it were furies; that is, when tiny have made their all to consist in (natural things).
The infernal Genius or fury...
On a furious crew, or on furies.

They who... have lived continually in quarrels, and in thefts... and who think nothing about the eternal life... and likewise those who are inwardly like them... after death become as it were furies. They appear naked, with dishevelled hair... (Fully described.)
He then began to rage like a madman... After these furies, they fell down as if dead; and, when resuscitated, they again raged in a similar way.
As it were fury kindles the infernals when they feel the sphere of marriage love.
If angelic Spirits speak about these two things in the World of Spirits, the Hells are violently moved, and they who are bound to the Hells as it were rage.
By the rod of fury () is signified the dominion of infernal falsity.
If that which flows in (from Heaven) is strong, it is turned into fury.
At the presence of marriage love, diabolical Spirits become furious.
